messages:
Amy (Sales): Heads-up — NexusHealth POC ready to spin up but procurement and legal paused on MSA/DPA redlines. Also, PO comes from a different legal entity than the signing contact. Need quick alignment for POC kickoff.
Matt (SE): POC spec: 3x A100 equiv, context 8k, daily token cap 50k. That influences the order form SKU math.
Nina (Procurement): @Amy can we start without a PO? They said payment will likely originate from NexusHealth, Inc. (US TAXID) but legal is routing through NexusHealth EU. If we need a PO we need the right entity on it.
Kevin (Finance): We can accept a corporate card for month-1 trial to avoid delays. For any committed capacity we require PO + billing entity + tax info. CC trial ok if <30 days and no advanced credits.
Amy (Sales): Prospect prefers CC for trial and Net45 for committed. Also asked if we can limit logs retention for the POC only, rather than permanent DPA changes.
Jordan (Legal): Redlines summary: they changed data-retention SLA and inserted KMS/HSM attestation text. We can't sign HSM attestation without a dedicated addendum. For retention, a signed POC appendix stating temporary 30-day retention would be acceptable.
Matt (SE): We can implement a time-limited retention override and log a proof tag. Example config:
```
service.poc.retention_days=30
audit.metadata.tags += ["nexus-poc-temp"]
```
This avoids changing the global DPA.
Nina (Procurement): Good. Procurement will allow CC for month-1 conditional on: (1) signed POC appendix for retention, (2) invoice contact provided, (3) no auto-conversion to committed billing without PO. Please send invoice contact details.
Kevin (Finance): Confirmed on conditional CC. Also need to know if tax is US (no VAT) or EU (VAT). If invoicing entity is US, we'll issue US invoice.
Amy (Sales): I'll collect billing contact and VAT/entity details tonight. One more: they want a signature sequence: legal -> finance -> exec. Does our e-sign flow support per-entity signature blocks?
Jordan (Legal): Yes. Order form should show explicit signature blocks for each legal entity (invoicing entity vs signing subsidiary). Use separate signature blocks and ensure the DocuSign routing order is set.
Matt (SE): Pricing question: POC quote included burst credits. Procurement asks to remove burst credits to keep predictable monthly cost. If we remove them, I'll update the SKU lines and hourly estimates.
Amy (Sales): We'll remove burst credits for the trial. Update order form accordingly.
Jordan (Legal): Action items: I'll draft a one-page POC appendix covering (a) 30-day retention exception, (b) KMS statement (no HSM attestation), and (c) explicit signature blocks per entity. Will circulate for internal review.
Nina (Procurement): Action: send invoice recipient to nina.procurement@nexushc.com and attach PO if they have one. We'll chase countersign once appendix is signed.
Kevin (Finance): Action: I'll clear CC trial on our side and hold for VAT/billing entity confirmation.
Amy (Sales): I'll update the order form (remove burst credits), capture billing contact, and confirm tax entity. Expect Jordan's appendix draft by EOD. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
